title: Every 1835 jaunt retold, each with its own light
items: All 27 jaunts of 1835 are retold as stories: an opening that sets the scene, stops that lead into the next, and the town's colour from Moses and Kirkland's History of Chicago, from Mark Beaubien's fiddle to the land-office crier on his white horse.

Each 1835 jaunt has its own time of day and season: Taverns of Chicago at night, the Fort Dearborn errand on a winter morning, Over the Draw on an autumn afternoon, Across Wolf Point at a spring daybreak.
